clarity.notes: Dark evening system reads immediately: glow hero → pinned card → three-structure feed → gallery → author/login. Old warm files kept for comparison.

hierarchy.notes: Unbounded display carries the page; one raised surface card (pinned post) dominates above the flat feed rows.

typography.notes: Serifs fully removed per user feedback; Unbounded (native Cyrillic, characterful) for display, system sans body at 17px/1.7 on the post page; tracking rules kept.

motion.notes: Single flourish: static amber lamp-glow radial in the hero (brief-mandated «вечерняя лампа»); amber reading-progress thread on the post; reduced-motion intact.

brand.notes: Warm charcoal (not pure black), amber accent used twice per screen (pinned kicker + login CTA; progress + blockquote rule), no purple, no glows beyond the one hero light.
